purpose: Teach: ルノー/葛飾/ジャッキー/ポーカー/ドラクエ/マスターズ/ワンセグ/スペースシャトル

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがルノーの車に乗せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to take you for a ride in his Renault.
lines.style: Warm, gentle announcement. Slight upward lilt on the child's name. Calm, present tone — sharing something nice without making a fuss about it. Settled.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと葛飾の柴又に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to go to Katsushika and Shibamata with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, eager opening on "Mom." Quick pace. Genuine excitement — the kind of thing a child says he really wants right now. Slight rise at the end, hoping. No performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジャッキーチェンの映画ファンなのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is actually a fan of Jackie Chan movies.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost amused undertone. Slight pause before the reveal. Warm observation — she's noticing something about her husband, sharing it without judgment. Matter-of-fact but tender.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとポーカーのルール習ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me the rules of poker.
lines.style: Quick, proud delivery. Straight forward — he's announcing something he accomplished. Genuine and unselfconscious. Small, real smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがドラクエの新作を予約されたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad has reserved the new Dragon Quest game.
lines.style: Quiet, knowing tone. Gentle pause before the reveal — she's noticed something and is sharing it with affection. Not gossiping, just noticing her husband's small enthusiasms. Composed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとマスターズの中継観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched the Masters tournament with Dad.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact. Pride underneath but not forced. He's reporting something that happened — shared time, treated as simply good. Quick finish, no trailing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがワンセグの携帯を使ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was using one of those old One-seg phones.
lines.style: Slight amusement in the observation. Gentle tone — noticing something a little dated about her husband without unkindness. Warm, almost tender humor. Conversational, not rushed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとスペースシャトル展行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad took me to the Space Shuttle exhibition.
lines.style: Open, bright delivery. Quick pace with genuine warmth. He's reporting something memorable — shared experience treated as something really good. Natural close, no trailing or undercut.
